en.t: Only then did the man stop walking.

units.source_text: 他往四下里望了望，用上衣袖子擦了擦汗。

en.t: He looked around in every direction, then wiped the sweat with the sleeve of his jacket.

units.source_text: 缓缓打开木箱，从上盖里，抽出几根木棒；扎起来，做了个捕虫网。

en.t: He slowly opened the wooden box, pulled several sticks from inside the lid, tied them together, and made an insect net.

units.source_text: 他用棒子的一头，敲打着草丛，又走了起来。

en.t: He tapped at the grass with one end of the stick and started walking again.

units.source_text: 沙滩上腾起了潮水的气息。

en.t: The smell of the tide rose from the sandy beach.
